'''Climm''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Marshal/Legends|marshal]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vaced/Legends|Vaced]]. In [[43 ABY]], Climm and his deputies met up with [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and his family after the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] had been briefly stolen by [[Cynner]] and [[Remata]].<ref name="Millennium Falcon" />
